draft.subject: Capgemini event budgets
draft.body:
I offer wedding photography packages for couples, so this may be a stretch.

I noticed GitLab’s global alliance with Capgemini. If that partnership creates client or partner events, my guess is someone has to sign off on the spend. I work with weddings, not corporate events, but I wanted to ask whether those budgets ever sit with finance at GitLab.

If Capgemini-linked events come up, do you handle that budget or does another team?
